paper.title: Meta-Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Model Harnesses
paper.central_claim: An agentic code-space optimizer with selective filesystem access to all prior code, scores and raw execution traces discovers better reusable LLM harnesses than compressed-feedback optimizers and hand-designed baselines across classification, retrieval math and agentic coding.

provenance.notes: Configured sonnet -> gpt-6.1-sol; independent receipt/session ID unavailable and not probed. Own a1 only; no other seat, attempt, aggregate or historical scores accessed. Card member outcomes/results not used as paper evidence or rating anchors.

sections_read: Appendices A.1–A.2, B.1–B.3, C.1–C.3, D, E

evidence.quote: Its key design choice is to expose
evidence.support_explanation: Uncompressed code/scores/traces are stored in a filesystem, accessed adaptively; the design changes proposer feedback, not weights.

evidence.quote: The proposer never sees test-set results; its only feedback comes from the
evidence.support_explanation: Explicit search-only feedback; population and Pareto frontier kept without a fixed parent rule.

evidence.quote: each harness is a single-file Python program
evidence.support_explanation: Swappable prompting/retrieval/memory/orchestration code; fixed proposer Opus-4.6, frozen execution model, minimal role skill.
Validation precedes expensive evaluation, and final output is a Pareto frontier, not every candidate promoted to deployment.

evidence.quote: we give each method the same budget of proposal harness evaluations.
evidence.support_explanation: Optimizer comparisons use same proposer and evaluation counts; this is not token/dollar parity.

evidence.quote: scores-only reaches 34.6 median and 41.3 best accuracy
evidence.support_explanation: Raw traces ablated against scores and summaries; full 50.0 median/56.7 best versus summary 34.9/38.7 are search-set candidate results, not heldout test or run variance.

evidence.quote: reaches 48.6% accuracy, outperforming ACE by 7.7 points and MCE by 8.6 points.
evidence.support_explanation: Selected harness test average vs ACE; 11.4K vs 50.8K added input tokens, distinct from optimizer cost.

evidence.quote: achieves the best average accuracy (73.1%), outperforming ACE (70.2%)
evidence.support_explanation: Nine unseen datasets test transfer of retained code; wins highest on 6/9, not universal.

evidence.quote: We select a single harness based on search-set performance using
evidence.support_explanation: 250-problem search set, 109 candidates/40 iterations, selected using GPT-OSS-20B; 200 new tasks and four additional models; three samples per problem. Five-model wording includes one selection model, so not five genuinely unseen executors.

evidence.quote: outperforming BM25 retrieval by 1.3 points overall
evidence.support_explanation: Average 38.8 vs 34.1 no retriever and 37.5 BM25; artifact reuses lexical retrieval stack.

evidence.quote: For this experiment, we perform search and final evaluation on the same 89-task benchmark.
evidence.support_explanation: Coding benchmark is a discovery set, not independent heldout evaluation; manual/regex string audits do not restore holdout.

evidence.quote: The structural bugfixes were confounded with harmful prompt changes.
evidence.support_explanation: Author-quoted proposer diagnosis and subsequent isolation; plausible trace attribution, not an independently proven causal explanation.

evidence.quote: After six consecutive regressions, the proposer shifts strategy
evidence.support_explanation: Failure candidates and a crash are disclosed; additive snapshot wins this search, not evidence of no regressions.

evidence.quote: The full implementation adds roughly 80 lines on top of Terminus-KIRA.
evidence.support_explanation: Retained coding artifact is a scoped environment-bootstrap patch with timeout, based on a fixed strong seed.

evidence.quote: using exact prefix matching followed by fuzzy Jaccard similarity (threshold 0.8)
evidence.support_explanation: Math corpus decontamination and truncation documented; semantic equivalence/pretraining overlap not fully audited.
Appendix practical tips conflict with §4.2 search count 250; unresolved implementation accounting, not assumed missing material.

evidence.quote: A search run completes in a few hours of wall-clock time
evidence.support_explanation: Coarse wallclock and fixed one-proposer limitation; no total proposer token/dollar accounting.

evidence.quote: Ctx denotes average additional characters in input context (thousands).
evidence.support_explanation: Table 9 reports 45.5K characters for selected harness whereas Table 2 uses 11.4K tokens; units differ, do not treat as a numeric contradiction or equate with full optimization cost.

evidence.quote: is the closest text optimizer in terms of feedback richness
evidence.support_explanation: GEPA and OpenEvolve are author-described and directly compared, but original sources unavailable for independent full lineage check.

signatures.conditions: Frozen executor, fixed external evaluator and strong coding proposer

signatures.failure_boundary: No formal statistical promotion rule; code crashes/regressions remain possible; code-space inspection does not certify generalization

signatures.selection_rule: Search-set Pareto frontier of accuracy and context
